summary: - **[key4hep/k4FWCore#459](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/459)** — OverlayTiming selects background SimCalorimeterHits relative to time of flight, matching signal and tracker hits, and adds ApplyTimeOfFlight; calorimeter TimeWindows tuned to the old behaviour may need revisiting.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#681](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/681)** — Adds v02 shape- and CAD-based FCC-ee MDI variants with a simple antisolenoid field and switches ILD_FCCee to the shape-based v02 MDI, fixing ILD tracking in inhomogeneous fields (see also **[key4hep/k4geo#694](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/694)**).

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#72](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/72)** — HepMCFileWriter gains a Format property for HepMC3 ROOT-tree output and a new default filename, gen_output.hepmc; HepMCFileReader auto-detects the input format, enabling compact ROOT-based generator files.

- **[key4hep/KKMCee#2](https://github.com/key4hep/KKMCee/pull/2)** — KKMCee uses the Gaussian beam-energy-spread mapping, which activates the upstream beam-energy-spread fix required for the FCC-ee Autumn 2026 production campaign.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#565](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/565)** — get_V0s_jet and get_SV_jets build each jet's vertices from its own tracks rather than other jets' tracks, changing per-jet V0 and SV outputs in pre-EDM4hep1 FCCAnalyses vertexing.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#564](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/564)** — Vertexing fixes for the pre-EDM4hep1 branch correct the SV pointing angle, SV angles relative to their jets, invariant-mass pairs and out-of-bounds reads, changing outputs of analyses using them.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#151](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/151)** — CLD and ILD_FCCee blueprints build ACTS sensor surfaces on the sensitive silicon instead of the passive module, restoring CLD endcap hits that were dropped from tracking.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#144](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/144)** — Endcap layer gaps on −z attach towards the IP, mirroring +z, so material receivers sit in front of their discs; existing ACTS material maps, including CLD's, must be regenerated.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#538](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/538)** — Adds fccanalysis submit grid, a DIRAC/ILCDIRAC backend that resolves EOS, XRootD or LFN inputs, plans deterministic jobs and submits FCCAnalyses runs to the grid.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#128](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/128)** — GGTFTrackFinder identifies input collections by their position instead of CollectionID, which is unassigned until writing, fixing reconstruction crashes in ALLEGRO and IDEA FCC-config workflows.
